effect.zh: 效果
effect.en: Effect

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，在你的每個回合開始時擲本表；後續若再擲出此結果，忽略它。
effect.en: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute, ignoring this result on subsequent rolls.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，只要視線未受阻擋，你就能看見隱形生物。
effect.en: For the next minute, you can see any invisible creature if you have line of sight to it.

effect.zh: 一個由 DM 選擇並控制的魔塚（modron）出現在你 5 呎內的未佔據空間，1 分鐘後消失。
effect.en: A modron chosen and controlled by the DM appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.

effect.zh: 你施放以自己為中心的 3 環火球術。
effect.en: You cast fireball as a 3rd-level spell centered on yourself.

effect.zh: 你施放 5 環魔法飛彈。
effect.en: You cast magic missile as a 5th-level spell.

effect.zh: 擲 d10，身高改變等同骰值的英吋數：奇數縮矮，偶數長高。
effect.en: Roll a d10. Your height changes by a number of inches equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you shrink. If the roll is even, you grow.

effect.zh: 你施放以自己為中心的困惑術。
effect.en: You cast confusion centered on yourself.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你在自己的每個回合開始時恢復 5 點生命值。
effect.en: For the next minute, you regain 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns.

effect.zh: 你長出一把羽毛構成的長鬍鬚，直到你打噴嚏時，羽毛才從臉上飛散。
effect.en: You grow a long beard made of feathers that remains until you sneeze, at which point the feathers explode out from your face.

effect.zh: 你施放以自己為中心的油膩術。
effect.en: You cast grease centered on yourself.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘內，你施放的下一個需要豁免檢定的法術，會使生物對它的豁免檢定具有劣勢。
effect.en: Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a saving throw.

effect.zh: 你的皮膚變成鮮豔的藍色；移除詛咒可以結束此效果。
effect.en: Your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue. A remove curse spell can end this effect.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你的額頭長出一隻眼睛；依賴視覺的感知（觀察）檢定具有優勢。
effect.en: For the next minute, an eye appears on your forehead and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你所有施法時間為 1 個動作的法術，施法時間都變為 1 個附贈動作。
effect.en: For the next minute, all your spells with a casting time of 1 action have a casting time of 1 bonus action.

effect.zh: 你傳送至 60 呎內一個你選擇且可見的未佔據空間。
effect.en: You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see.

effect.zh: 你被傳送到星界位面，直到你下個回合結束，之後回到原本空間；若該空間已被佔據，改為最近的未佔據空間。
effect.en: You are transported to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, after which time you return to the space you previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘內，你施放的下一個傷害法術造成最大傷害。
effect.en: Maximize the damage of the next damaging spell you cast within the next minute.

effect.zh: 擲 d10，年齡改變等同骰值的年數：奇數變年輕（最低 1 歲），偶數變年長。
effect.en: Roll a d10. Your age changes by a number of years equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you get younger (minimum 1 year old). If the roll is even, you get older.

effect.zh: 1d6 隻由 DM 控制的飛絮怪（flumph）出現在你 60 呎內的未佔據空間，並因你而陷入恐慌。牠們在 1 分鐘後消失。
effect.en: 1d6 flumphs controlled by the DM appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you and are frightened of you. They vanish after 1 minute.

effect.zh: 你恢復 2d10 點生命值。
effect.en: You regain 2d10 hit points.

effect.zh: 你變成盆栽植物，直到你下個回合開始。此形態下你陷入失能，且對所有傷害具有易傷。若生命值降至 0，花盆碎裂，你恢復原形。
effect.en: You turn into a potted plant until the start of your next turn. While a plant, you are incapacitated and have vulnerability to all damage. If you drop to 0 hit points, your pot breaks, and your form reverts.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你可在自己的每個回合用附贈動作傳送至多 20 呎。
effect.en: For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.

effect.zh: 你對自己施放浮空術。
effect.en: You cast levitate on yourself.

effect.zh: 一隻由 DM 控制的獨角獸出現在你 5 呎內的空間，1 分鐘後消失。
effect.en: A unicorn controlled by the DM appears in a space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你無法說話；每當你嘗試說話，粉紅色泡泡就從口中飄出。
effect.en: You can't speak for the next minute. Whenever you try, pink bubbles float out of your mouth.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，一面幽靈盾牌漂浮在你附近，使你的 AC 獲得 +2 加值，並使你免疫魔法飛彈。
effect.en: A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting you a +2 bonus to AC and immunity to magic missile.

effect.zh: 接下來 5d6 天，你免疫酒精的醉酒效果。
effect.en: You are immune to being intoxicated by alcohol for the next 5d6 days.

effect.zh: 你的頭髮全部脫落，但會在 24 小時內重新長出。
effect.en: Your hair falls out but grows back within 24 hours.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你觸碰的任何易燃物品，若未被其他生物穿戴或攜帶，就會起火。
effect.en: For the next minute, any flammable object you touch that isn't being worn or carried by another creature bursts into flame.

effect.zh: 你恢復一個已消耗的法術位，環級為你已消耗法術位中的最低環級。
effect.en: You regain your lowest-level expended spell slot.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，每當你說話時都必須大喊。
effect.en: For the next minute, you must shout when you speak.

effect.zh: 你施放以自己為中心的雲霧術。
effect.en: You cast fog cloud centered on yourself.

effect.zh: 你選擇的、距離你 30 呎內至多三個生物，各受到 4d10 閃電傷害。
effect.en: Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take 4d10 lightning damage.

effect.zh: 你因最近的生物而陷入恐慌，直到你下個回合結束。
effect.en: You are frightened by the nearest creature until the end of your next turn.

effect.zh: 你周圍 30 呎內的每個生物隱形，持續 1 分鐘。某個生物攻擊或施法時，該生物的隱形結束。
effect.en: Each creature within 30 feet of you becomes invisible for the next minute. The invisibility ends on a creature when it attacks or casts a spell.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你對所有傷害具有抗性。
effect.en: You gain resistance to all damage for the next minute.

effect.zh: 你 60 呎內一個隨機生物陷入中毒，持續 1d4 小時。
effect.en: A random creature within 60 feet of you becomes poisoned for 1d4 hours.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你在 30 呎半徑內發出明亮光照。任何在你 5 呎內結束回合的生物都會目盲，直到該生物下個回合結束。
effect.en: You glow with bright light in a 30-foot radius for the next minute. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you is blinded until the end of its next turn.

effect.zh: 你對自己施放變形術；若豁免失敗，你在法術持續時間內變成綿羊。
effect.en: You cast polymorph on yourself. If you fail the saving throw, you turn into a sheep for the spell's duration.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，幻象蝴蝶與花瓣在你周圍 10 呎內飄舞。
effect.en: Illusory butterflies and flower petals flutter in the air within 10 feet of you for the next minute.

effect.zh: 你可以立刻採取一個額外動作。
effect.en: You can take one additional action immediately.

effect.zh: 你周圍 30 呎內的每個生物受到 1d10 黯蝕傷害。你恢復的生命值等於此次造成的黯蝕傷害總和。
effect.en: Each creature within 30 feet of you takes 1d10 necrotic damage. You regain hit points equal to the sum of the necrotic damage dealt.

effect.zh: 你對自己施放鏡影術。
effect.en: You cast mirror image.

effect.zh: 你對 60 呎內一個隨機生物施放飛行術。
effect.en: You cast fly on a random creature within 60 feet of you.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你隱形，其他生物也聽不見你。若你攻擊或施法，隱形效果結束。
effect.en: You become invisible for the next minute. During that time, other creatures can't hear you. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.

effect.zh: 若你在接下來 1 分鐘內死亡，會立刻如同受到轉生術（reincarnate）般重獲生命。
effect.en: If you die within the next minute, you immediately come back to life as if by the reincarnate spell.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你的體型增大一個尺寸類別。
effect.en: Your size increases by one size category for the next minute.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你與周圍 30 呎內所有生物對穿刺傷害具有易傷。
effect.en: You and all creatures within 30 feet of you gain vulnerability to piercing damage for the next minute.

effect.zh: 接下來 1 分鐘，你周圍環繞著微弱的空靈音樂。
effect.en: You are surrounded by faint, ethereal music for the next minute.

effect.zh: 你恢復所有已消耗的術法點。
effect.en: You regain all expended sorcery points.
